adds.title: Avengers: Infinity War
adds.text: T'Challa brings the Avengers to Shuri, who works to remove the Mind Stone from Vision while her brother leads Wakanda's army against Thanos's forces.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Her brother. Leads Wakanda's defense while she works on Vision.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: His sister. Works to free the Mind Stone from Vision while he holds the line.
adds.evidence: Infinity War: Shuri is tasked by her brother to help the Avengers at the Wakanda medical center and works to extract the Mind Stone while T'Challa and the Wakandan forces mount the defense.

adds.title: Avengers: Endgame
adds.text: Back from the dust, Shuri and T'Challa step through a portal together to join the final battle, then go home to Wakanda to reunite with their mother.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Her brother. Back from the dust, they fight side by side and go home to their mother.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: His sister. Back from the dust, they fight side by side and go home to their mother.
adds.evidence: Endgame: restored by the Blip, Shuri walks alongside T'Challa and Okoye through a portal into the Battle of Earth; afterwards Shuri and T'Challa return to Wakanda to reunite with Ramonda, and attend Tony's funeral together.

adds.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
adds.text: Disguised as Maria Hill and Nick Fury, Soren and Talos run Fury's operation with Peter. Afterward Soren presses Talos to tell Fury what happened, and he calls him.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Her husband. Poses as Fury while she poses as Hill.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: His wife. Poses as Hill and makes him call Fury.
adds.evidence: Far From Home: Talos and Soren impersonate Fury and Hill throughout, working together through the Elemental attacks and the Battle of London; in the post-credits scene they revert and Soren tells Talos he has to tell Fury, and he calls him.

adds.title: Avengers: Endgame
adds.text: Back from the dust, Hope comes home with Scott to a five-years-older Cassie, and the three of them sit outside together watching the fireworks.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Scott's daughter, five years older when Hope comes back.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Her dad's partner, home with him to watch the fireworks.
adds.evidence: Endgame: after the battle, Hope and Scott go to Jim Paxton's house in San Francisco to reunite with Cassie; the three sit outside and watch the fireworks celebrating the Blip. Kind kept as friend: the family stage starts at Quantumania.

adds.title: X2
adds.text: Raven joins the X-Men to find the captive Xavier, then, posing as Stryker, has Jason turn Xavier's Cerebro against every human on Earth.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Uses him as a weapon against humanity while posing as Stryker.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The captive she turns against every human.
adds.evidence: X2: the X-Men team up with Magneto and Mystique to rescue Xavier; at Alkali Lake, Magneto stops Cerebro and, with Mystique impersonating Stryker to command Jason, has Xavier redirect its power on humans.

adds.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
adds.text: Still a couple, Negasonic and Yukio come to Wade's surprise birthday party and join his friends again for dinner a few days later.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Her girlfriend. Comes with her to Wade's birthday party.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Her girlfriend. Comes with her to Wade's birthday party.
adds.evidence: Deadpool & Wolverine: Negasonic is invited to Wade's surprise birthday party along with Yukio and Colossus; a few days later the guests get together again for dinner. Wikipedia cast list still describes Yukio as Negasonic's girlfriend.

adds.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#66
adds.text: Cable, a soldier from the future, fights beside Scott and the X-Men to destroy Apocalypse's Lazarus Chamber and free the captive psychics, then takes them home in his time ship.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A soldier from the future who fights Apocalypse beside Scott.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The X-Men's leader, who fights Apocalypse beside Cable.
adds.evidence: Beyond Good and Evil Part 4 (#66, script order): Cable and the X-Men (Cyclops appearing) destroy the Lazarus Chamber, track Xavier to the Axis of Time, defeat Apocalypse's Horsemen, and Cable's time ship returns everyone to the Mansion. Kind ally: neither knows they are father and son yet; family starts at X-Men '97#2.

none.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.#106
none.why: #106 is All Roads Lead..., which is S5#18 (88 episodes before season 5). The tie already has that stage: Ruby kills Werner when she cannot control the gravitonium. Same episode under another title form.

none.title: Ant-Man
none.why: They never meet. Hope works with Scott and Hank; Cassie is only with Scott, Maggie and Paxton, and Cross takes her hostage while Hope is with the wounded Hank. Hope first meets Cassie in Ant-Man and the Wasp.

none.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
none.why: Separate storylines. Magneto frees Mystique, she loses her powers to the cure dart and gives up his base; Xavier dies at Jean's house. They never deal with each other.

none.title: Dark Phoenix
none.why: Peter is injured early in the skirmish at Jean's childhood home and drops out; Erik is on Genosha and later fights alongside the X-Men without Peter. No scene together.

none.title: Spider-Man (1994)#18
none.why: Mutants' Revenge: Scott and Jean arrive with the rest of the X-Men in the Blackbird to help stop Landon. A team scene only; Jean does not speak and they never deal with each other.

none.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#66
none.why: The 'Jean Grey' in Beyond Good and Evil is Madelyne Pryor (Sinister swapped them, as the tie's own X-Men '97#3 stage on Scott and Jean says); the Marvel Database lists her as Madelyne posing as Jean. The real Jean is not there.

none.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#49
none.why: Sanctuary Part 2: Polaris is only a cameo among X-Factor and the mutants around Asteroid M. She never deals with Magneto.

none.title: X-Men '97#19
none.why: Mystique is only in the mid-credits scene, where she shoots Val Cooper and takes her place while reading a redacted file. Rogue is in the main story with Eson and Gambit. No scene or dealings between them.

none.title: X-Men '97#19
none.why: Mystique is only in the mid-credits scene with Val Cooper. Kurt gives his life to Eson in the main story. They never deal with each other.

none.title: X-Men '97#19
none.why: Mid-credits: Mystique shoots Cooper and takes her identity while Graydon's election plays out. The Marvel Database lists Graydon as on screen only (on a TV). No direct dealing.

owner_calls.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
owner_calls.question: Which cut counts for Rogue and Bobby? In the theatrical cut Rogue is only a brief cameo in the restored future at the end, where Logan sees them back at the school. In the Rogue Cut, Bobby and Magneto rescue Rogue from the Sentinels' lab in the Mansion, she absorbs his power to wake, and Bobby dies holding off the Sentinels so she can escape.
options: Add a partner stage from the Rogue Cut: Bobby rescues Rogue from the Sentinels' lab and dies holding them off so she can escape
Add a short partner stage for the restored future: together again at the school
owner_calls.evidence: The Rogue Cut adds Rogue's rescue by Iceman and Magneto and Iceman's death; theatrical release reduced her role to a brief cameo.

owner_calls.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#65
owner_calls.question: Proposed the Scott/Cable ally stage on #66 as listed, but the dealing starts one episode earlier: in Beyond Good and Evil Part 3 (#65) Cable lands in the present and recruits the X-Men, Cyclops among them, to destroy the Lazarus Chamber in ancient Cairo. Should the stage start at #65 instead?
options: Move it to #65 (Cable recruits the X-Men to go after the Lazarus Chamber)
owner_calls.evidence: Marvel Database lists Cyclops among the featured X-Men in Part 3, where Cable recruits the X-Men for his mission.

owner_calls.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.#106
owner_calls.question: The tie's stage is on 'Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5#18', which is the same episode as '#106'. It was listed as missing, so the app may not be matching the two title forms. Does the watch check map S5#18 to #106?
options: Check the app's title mapping for season-titled AoS stages
owner_calls.evidence: Seasons 1 to 4 have 22 episodes each, so #106 is S5#18, All Roads Lead....
